summary: Well-written implementation (pure functions, explicit types, thoughtful error handling). Workflow YAML has pinned actions and least-privilege permissions. Critical gaps prevent execution: missing test files (validator.test.ts, report.test.ts, cli.test.ts), fixture file (fixtures/secrets.json), and act-result.txt generation step. Workflow will fail at runtime—references non-existent tests and fixtures. Task mandates all tests via `act` producing act-result.txt artifact; neither implemented. Minor: `bun-version: latest` unpinned; inline Bun `-e` commands for JSON extraction are fragile.
